note: Layout Builder Search API provides a single Search API processor plugin, layout_builder_references (stage add_properties), plus the layoutbuilder_search_api.manager service. You enable the processor on a Search API index, pick which block_content_types to expose, then add the generated search_api_layoutbuilder_references_<bundle> fields on the index's Fields tab; at index time it extracts fields from the inline_block and placed block_content components in an entity's Layout Builder layout. IMPORTANT / HONESTY: on this site's core (Drupal 11.4.4) version 1.0.3 is broken — the processor declares an untyped `protected $sectionStorageManager` that collides with core's LayoutEntityHelperTrait typed property of the same name, so PHP fatals the instant the processor class is instantiated (enabling it on an index, saving such an index, or even reading its plugin definition through the search_api processor manager). Because every introspection/execution fixture would have to instantiate the processor and would crash the site command, only the recipe (easy) tier is authored here; medium (introspection) and hard (execution) tiers are intentionally omitted and the reason is documented, rather than shipping smoke-tests that cannot pass. The easy prompts are graded purely on response text and do not touch the live processor.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using Layout Builder and Search API, I want to index the fields of blocks placed in a node's Layout Builder layout instead of the rendered page HTML. Which module and Search API processor make this possible, and where do I enable it?
evals.expected_output: The Layout Builder Search API module provides the 'Layout builder references' (layout_builder_references) Search API processor. Enable it on a Search API index via the index's Processors tab, then select which block content types to expose and add their fields on the Fields tab.

evals.prompt: How is the layout_builder_references Search API processor configured, and what does it add to the index? Name the setting you choose and the pattern of the properties/fields it generates.
evals.expected_output: In the processor settings you tick the Block Content Types to expose (config key block_content_types). For each selected type it generates an entity-reference property named search_api_layoutbuilder_references_<bundle>; you then add that property's nested block fields on the index's Fields tab.

evals.prompt: Does the layout_builder_references processor index rendered page HTML or actual block field values? Which kinds of Layout Builder blocks does it cover, and by which revision?
evals.expected_output: It indexes actual block field values, not rendered HTML. It covers both inline_block components and placed reusable block_content components in the entity's Layout Builder layout, loading each block's current revision (via block_revision_id / the component UUID) and extracting the requested fields.
